author: buihainam
reason: v0 showed 3 wrong_tool failures (H04 H13 H17): inspect_device defaulted check to 'all' instead of the symptom-specific value, and the model called inspect_device with an employee_id after lookup_user even though lookup_user already returns assigned devices.
hypothesis: If inspect_device.check description tells the model to pick the specific subsystem named by the user instead of defaulting to 'all', and lookup_user's description states it already includes assigned devices, H04/H13/H17 will pass without regressing other cases.

author: buihainam
reason: v1 still failed missing_info cases (H10 H11 H19): the model guessed asset_id/employee_id/environment values from vague descriptions ('my laptop', 'Sales colleague', 'demo') instead of asking. First v2 attempt added a rule to call clarify on vague identifiers, which fixed routing but left response_type/options unset (H10/H11/H19 still failed on args); added a second rule telling the model how to set response_type per question kind.
hypothesis: Adding an explicit no-guessing rule plus response_type guidance for clarify will make H10/H11/H19 pass fully.

author: buihainam
reason: v2 still failed wrong_boundary cases (H12 M05 M09): the model called create_ticket with confirmed=true without ever asking a yes_no clarify first, and kept an old confirmation valid after the ticket payload changed.
hypothesis: Requiring an explicit clarify(yes_no) restating summary/priority/asset_id before create_ticket, and treating any payload change as invalidating a prior confirmation, will make H12/M05/M09 pass without regressing the confirm_write-adjacent cases.
